name: print-social-big-ideas-great-design-poster-white-orange-blue-blocks
title: 'Big Ideas Great Design' poster with orange and blue colour-block photos and scribble doodles
whatItIs: A white A4 poster with a paintbrush and pen-tool doodle in the corners, a bold orange 'BIG IDEAS GREAT DESIGN' headline, an '@GSCOMUNIC' handle, a blue text block and an orange text block flanking two black-and-white photos of a designer at work, small confetti diamonds and a tablet illustration.
whatItMeans: Confident and hands-on; real work photos paired with bold colour blocks make design services feel personal and demonstrably skilled.
techniques: Alternate colour-block text panels beside greyscale work photos.
Scatter hand-tool doodles (brush, pen tool) as thematic decoration.
Mark corners with small confetti diamond shapes.

vocabulary.definition: A solid rectangle of colour holding text.
A small scattered diamond shape used as decoration.
